verdict.summary: A clean single-storey glass-fronted box with a flat roof that reads as a modern shop, but the café's defining features (neon sign, outdoor terrace, timber soffit) are missing, so it could be any modern retail unit.

issues.problem: No neon-style sign anywhere on the fascia or roofline; the building has no café identity
issues.fix: Add a glowing sign band (e.g. light-blue or warm neon via glowstone/sea lantern lines or glass-pane lettering) on the front fascia above the glazing, set proud of the roof edge so it reads from the street.

issues.problem: Outdoor terrace with tables and planters is absent; front is bare plinth and glass
issues.fix: Lay a raised terrace (stone-brick or smooth stone slab) 1-2 blocks out from the front glazing, with 3-4 fence/stair-block tables with seats and corner planters with flowers or leaves.

issues.problem: Cantilever underside is grey/stone, not timber; roof reads as a lid on a box
issues.fix: Clad the soffit (underside of the overhang along the front and sides) in spruce or oak slabs or planks, and extend the overhang 1-2 blocks past the wall line so the cantilever shows in shadow.

issues.problem: Black wall panels dominate the sides and back, making large blank dark areas between glazing
issues.fix: Replace the wide black wall sections on the two glazed sides with full-height glass panels between thin dark steel mullions (iron bars or dark prismarine-style frame), keeping black only for the thin mullions and corners.

issues.problem: Six glowing teal squares on the roof read as lights or hatches, not skylights
issues.fix: Flush them with the roof surface as glass or light-blue stained glass panes, or remove them so the roof reads as a clean flat slab.
